title: Sziget Festival
metaDescription: Sziget Festival: confirmed dates, venue and planning information for music travellers.

overview.about: Sziget is one of Europe's biggest music festivals, held every August on Obuda Island in the middle of Budapest. Nicknamed the 'Island of Freedom', its week-long, camp-on-site format and hugely international crowd make it as much a cultural gathering as a concert series.
overview.nextEvent: The next Sziget runs in August on Obuda Island, Budapest. A week of dozens of stages and around-the-clock programming draws a young, international audience who camp on the island for the duration.

@graph.name: Sziget Festival
@graph.description: Sziget Festival brings five days of music, art and late-night programming to Óbudai-sziget, the island venue in Budapest known by the festival as the Island of Freedom. The 2026 event is scheduled for 11–15 August, with the party continuing into Sunday morning after the final programmed day. Its scale is reflected in the announced main-stage bill, which includes Bring Me The Horizon, Florence + The Machine, Lewis Capaldi, Twenty One Pilots, Zara Larsson, Underworld and many more artists across genres. The festival is not limited to a single concert stage: the island operates as a temporary festival district, and its official information covers access, camping, travel, safety and cashless payment as well as music. For planning, use the official address in Budapest and the published entry guidance; artist and timetable updates should come from Sziget itself because stage times can change before the gates open.
